settings.motionBlocked.osMessage: Your operating system is asking apps to reduce motion, so this effect can't play even though it's switched on here. On Windows, turn on Show animations (Settings > Accessibility > Display, or Ease of Access > Display on Windows 10); on macOS turn off Reduce motion; on Android turn off Remove animations. Your saved setting is kept and will take effect once the OS allows motion again.
